title: Headcount: a Claude Code setup where agents are split by which files they own, not by topic
description:
Headcount turns Claude Code into an org chart instead of one prompt. It ships 16 departments and 143 skills, engineering to legal, and each installs as its own plugin, so a project loads only what it needs. Agents split by exclusive write surfaces, what they own, not by topic, so two agents can't quietly step on the same file. Security and legal sit above the rest as reviewers, and they can block a change.

https://github.com/cbrock84/headcount
